meta.name: mindmap
meta.description: Create hierarchical mind maps using PlantUML @startmindmap syntax. Best for brainstorming, topic decomposition, study notes, and decision trees with automatic radial layout, left/right branches, and per-node styling.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字快速生成层级思维导图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把想法快速整理成可视化结构图
copy.tagline_en: Generate hierarchical mind maps from text quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas into visual mind maps fast

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的文字描述，生成树状思维导图。你只需用星号或加减号表示层级，Claude 会输出 PlantUML 代码，渲染成带颜色和分支方向的导图。
howto.when: 当你需要梳理思路、分解主题、做笔记或决策分析时，可以要求 Claude 生成思维导图。

say.text: 帮我用思维导图梳理产品发布计划
say.note: Claude 会生成一个以产品发布为中心的层级导图。

say.text: 用左右分支对比优缺点
say.note: Claude 会生成左右两侧分别展示优点和缺点的导图。

say.text: 给根节点用蓝色，子节点用绿色
say.note: Claude 会应用你指定的颜色到对应节点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate hierarchical mind maps from your text description. You use asterisks or plus/minus signs for levels, and Claude outputs PlantUML code that renders into a diagram with colors and branch directions.
howto.when_en: When you need to organize ideas, decompose topics, take study notes, or analyze decisions, you can ask Claude to generate a mind map.

say_en.text: Create a mind map for product launch plan
say_en.note: Claude will generate a hierarchical map centered on product launch.

say_en.text: Use left and right branches for pros and cons
Color root blue and child nodes green
say_en.note: Claude will apply the specified colors to the nodes.
